points: BSI department head Timo Hauschild: enforcement initiative begins in Q4 2026, starting with hearings rather than immediate fines
From Q1 2027 the BSI can order individual entities to audit their IT security and submit evidence
20,373 registrations by 30 September 2026 against almost 30,000 expected entities
read: ChannelPartner report on BSI statements to Tagesspiegel Background (8 October 2026)
take: Germany moves from counting NIS2 registrations to enforcing them. Unregistered firms face hearings and possible fines now; KRITIS operators are contacted first.
title: BSI: NIS2 enforcement starts this quarter, ordered audits from 2027
